source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of print spooling (PDF 104-105).

blocks.text: Print spooling printer ko bheje gaye print jobs sambhalti hai. Documents aane ki tarteeb mein queue mein rakhe jate hain, to pehle bheja document pehle chhapta aur baqi apni baari ka intezar karte hain. Is se documents be-tarteeb chhapne ya ek saath bhejne par takrane se bachte hain.

blocks.prompt: Teen log 9:00, 9:01 aur 9:02 par ek printer ko documents bhejte hain. Pehle kaunsa chhapta hai?
blocks.explanation: 9:00 wala document, kyunke print queue first in, first out hai.

items: Print spooling: print jobs FIFO queue mein intezar kar ke aane ki tarteeb se chhapte hain.
